summary: Describes encodings, identifiers, and parameter formats for using the GOST R 34.10-2012 and GOST R 34.11-2012 algorithms in the Internet X.509 public key infrastructure. It exists to help implementations that want GOST support, and does not imply IETF endorsement of the algorithms. It is informational.

eli5.summary: This explains how certificates can carry the Russian signature and hash tools in the right format.
